front: A floating gem shields the target, absorbing some attacks. When it breaks, it explodes and slashes whoever destroyed it.
back:
Gem has 5 HP. Each time a creature Strikes the target, target attempts a DC 11 flat check; on success the gem blocks it, takes the damage first, and the target takes any remainder.
At 0 HP it shatters: 1d8 slashing (basic Reflex) to the creature that destroyed it, if within 10 feet of the target.
Heightened (+1): gem has +5 HP; detonation +1d8.
